page: Vultr voc-s-16c-128gb-2560s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an AMD EPYC processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of a 2560 GB NVMe SSD. No GPU hardware is present on this instance type.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong memory performance, with the PassMark memory score and large-block read-only and write memory bandwidth tests placing in the top 25% of tested servers. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is also strong. Multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, and database operations fall within the average range. The server achieves an average static web serving throughput of 15.75 GB/sec and processes Redis SET operations at 36.59 million operations per second.

Given its dedicated AMD EPYC cores, high memory-to-vCPU ratio, and large bundled NVMe storage, this server offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. It is well-suited for hosting databases, running memory-cached applications, executing software compilation pipelines, and handling general-purpose enterprise workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation and fast local storage.
